svg.title: Raft leader election and log replication
svg.text: raft-kv: a leader fails, a new term is elected, replication resumes
replicated log, one box per index; the bar underneath means committed and applied to the KV store
term 1: node1 leads and AppendEntries heartbeats keep both followers' election timers reset
node1 stops responding, so the randomized election timeout on the followers expires
node2 increments to term 2, votes for itself and fans out RequestVote
node3 grants the vote after the up-to-date log check: two of three is a majority, node2 is leader
leader appends client commands, tracks matchIndex per peer, advances commitIndex on majority, then applies
Orange pulses are AppendEntries, purple are RequestVote, green are successful responses.
A vote is only granted if the candidate log is at least as up to date, which is what keeps committed entries safe.
Every append is fsynced into the per-node WAL before it counts, so a restarted node replays its log.
A follower that receives a write rejects it with a not-leader error and the current leader hint.
